[package]
name = "boring"
version = "5.2.0"
authors = ["Steven Fackler <sfackler@gmail.com>", "Ivan Nikulin <ifaaan@gmail.com>"]
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "BoringSSL bindings"
repository = "https://github.com/cloudflare/boring"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/boring"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["tls", "ssl", "dtls", "post-quantum", "fips"]
categories = ["cryptography", "api-bindings"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["rpk", "underscore-wildcards", "mlkem", "mldsa"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = []
fips = ["boring-sys/fips"]
legacy-compat-deprecated = []
pq-experimental = []
mlkem = []
mldsa = []
prf = []
credential = []
rpk = ["credential", "boring-sys/rpk"]
underscore-wildcards = ["boring-sys/underscore-wildcards"]
relax-cert-validation = ["boring-sys/relax-cert-validation"]
fips-precompiled = ["fips"]

[dependencies]
bitflags = "2.9"
foreign-types = "0.5"
openssl-macros = "0.1.1"
libc = "0.2"

[dependencies.boring-sys]
version = "5.2.0"
path = "./boring-sys"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies]
hex = "0.4"
rusty-hook = "^0.11"
brotli = "8.0"

[package]
name = "boring-sys"
version = "5.2.0"
authors = ["Alex Crichton <alex@alexcrichton.com>", "Steven Fackler <sfackler@gmail.com>", "Ivan Nikulin <ifaaan@gmail.com>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "FFI bindings to BoringSSL"
repository = "https://github.com/cloudflare/boring"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/boring-sys"
links = "boringssl"
build = "build/main.rs"
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["cryptography", "external-ffi-bindings"]
keywords = ["tls", "boringssl", "openssl", "fips", "ml-kem"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"
include = ["/*.md", "/*.toml", "/LICENSE-MIT", "/cmake/*.cmake", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.[chS]", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.inc", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.asm", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.pl", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.go", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.cmake", "/deps/boringssl/**/go.mod", "/deps/boringssl/**/go.sum", "/deps/boringssl/crypto/obj/obj_mac.num", "/deps/boringssl/crypto/obj/objects.txt", "/deps/boringssl/crypto/err/*.errordata", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.bzl", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.cc", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.cpp", "/deps/boringssl/**/*.in", "/deps/boringssl/**/CMakeLists.txt", "/deps/boringssl/**/sources.cmake", "/deps/boringssl/**/util/go_tests.txt", "/deps/boringssl/LICENSE", "/build/*", "/src", "/patches"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["rpk", "underscore-wildcards", "mlkem"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
fips = []
rpk = []
mlkem = []
allow-crl-extensions-bad-version = []
underscore-wildcards = []
relax-cert-validation = []

[build-dependencies]
cmake = "0.1.54"
fs_extra = "1.3.0"
fslock = "0.2"

[build-dependencies.bindgen]
version = "0.72.0"
default-features = false
features = ["runtime"]

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "allow"
check-cfg = ["cfg(const_fn)"]

[package]
name = "spqr"
version = "1.5.3"
edition = "2021"
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.88.0"

[dependencies]
displaydoc = "0.2"
hax-lib = "0.3.7"
hkdf = "0.13"
libcrux-hmac = "0.0.8"
log = "0.4.21"
num_enum = "0.7.3"
prost = "0.14.1"
rand = "0.9"
rand_core = "0.9"
sha2 = "0.11"
sorted-vec = "0.8.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
version = "5.0.0"
features = ["rand_core"]

[dependencies.libcrux-ml-kem]
version = "0.0.10"
default-features = false
features = ["incremental", "mlkem768"]

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11"
galois_field_2pm = "0.1.0"
hex = "0.4"
hmac = "0.13"
matches = "0.1.10"
proptest = "1.7"
rand_distr = "0.5.1"

[dev-dependencies.spqr]
path = "."
features = ["test-utils"]

[build-dependencies]
prost-build = "0.14.1"

[features]
proof = []
test-utils = []

[target."cfg(any(target_arch = \"aarch64\", target_arch = \"x86_64\", target_arch = \"x86\"))".dependencies]
cpufeatures = "0.3"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(hax)"]

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 2

[package]
name = "tokio-boring"
version = "5.2.0"
authors = ["Alex Crichton <alex@alexcrichton.com>", "Ivan Nikulin <ifaaan@gmail.com>"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"
repository = "https://github.com/cloudflare/boring"
homepage = "https://github.com/cloudflare/boring"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/tokio-boring"
description = "An implementation of SSL streams for Tokio backed by BoringSSL\n"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["rpk"]
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["boring/default"]
fips = ["boring/fips", "boring-sys/fips"]
rpk = ["boring/rpk"]

[dependencies]
tokio = "1"

[dependencies.boring]
default-features = false
version = "5.2.0"
path = "./boring"

[dependencies.boring-sys]
default-features = false
version = "5.2.0"
path = "./boring-sys"

[dev-dependencies]
futures = "0.3"
anyhow = "1"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
version = "1"

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/signalapp/boring"]
git = "https://github.com/signalapp/boring"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "signal-v5.2.0"

[source."https://github.com/signalapp/sparsepostquantumratchet"]
git = "https://github.com/signalapp/sparsepostquantumratchet"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
tag = "v1.5.3"
